title: Voice Assistant and AI Food Search Enhancement

voice_assistant: Gemini intent extraction for finance and meal logging
Finance and meal confirmation before persistence
food_search: AI fallback when no suitable food result exists

voice.current_behavior: Speech/text command is parsed then immediately persisted.

food_search.actual_provider: OpenRouter free model, optionally fed DuckDuckGo snippets
food_search.current_behavior: FoodCache search runs first. User can request AI result or manually enter nutrition when no result exists.

findings.finding: AI-parsed financial transactions persist without an explicit user confirmation step.
findings.risk: Incorrect amount, category, account, or date changes real financial records and account balances.

findings.finding: Unmatched account and category fall back to first available record.
findings.risk: A transaction can be written to an unrelated account or category.

findings.finding: Voice-created transactions are saved with source manual.
findings.risk: Audit trail and UI source indicator are incorrect.

findings.finding: Schema does not require or validate amount, transaction type, date, account match, or category match before persistence.
findings.risk: Malformed or ambiguous AI output can create invalid data.

findings.finding: AI meal results persist immediately and can partially save when one food in a multi-food command fails.
findings.risk: Daily nutrition totals become incomplete or inconsistent.

findings.finding: Prompt defines gram nutrition values per 100g, but persistence multiplies values directly by gram quantity.
findings.risk: Example: 200g food with 34 kcal per 100g can be stored as 6800 kcal instead of 68 kcal.

findings.finding: AI food fallback is labelled Gemini in UI and route naming but uses OpenRouter free model.
findings.risk: User-facing provider disclosure and operational debugging are inaccurate.

findings.finding: AI-generated nutrition is cached permanently as FoodCache data without source URL, model, timestamp, confidence, or verification state.
findings.risk: Hallucinated or stale results become future database results.

findings.finding: DuckDuckGo HTML snippets are scraped with brittle parsing and supplied to the model without trusted-source filtering.
findings.risk: Incorrect, stale, manipulated, or brand-mismatched nutrition data can be used.

findings.finding: OpenRouter 429 handling recursively retries without an attempt limit; external request has no timeout.
findings.risk: Long-running requests, repeated cost, and unavailable UI.

findings.finding: AI fallback errors are swallowed in UI and user is returned to form without actionable error feedback.
findings.risk: User cannot distinguish no result, quota issue, network failure, or invalid AI response.

findings.finding: Search queries are interpolated into MongoDB regex without escaping and have no maximum length or rate limit.
findings.risk: Unexpected matching, expensive regex work, and endpoint abuse.

findings.finding: AI nutrition result has no editable review state or visible uncertainty/source warning before meal save.
findings.risk: Users may treat an estimate as verified nutrition data.

tasks.title: Create shared nutrition unit normalization
work: Define explicit nutrition basis: per_gram, per_100g, or per_unit.
Convert all AI and cache results to one canonical storage basis.
Fix voice meal calculation for 100g responses.
Validate calories and macros are finite, non-negative, and plausibly bounded.
Add focused tests for 100g, gram, piece, and serving calculations.

tasks.title: Split voice parsing from persistence
work: Change server action from parse-and-save to parse-only preview response.
Return typed, validated finance or meal draft.
Create separate confirmed persistence action.
Reject ambiguous, incomplete, or unmatched fields instead of guessing.

tasks.title: Build voice confirmation and edit UI
work: Show parsed finance draft: type, amount, account, category, description, date.
Show parsed meal draft: meal type, food rows, quantity, unit, calories, macros.
Provide confirm, cancel, and edit actions.
Keep current transcript visible while user reviews draft.
Prevent duplicate confirmation while persistence is in progress.

tasks.title: Make voice finance matching deterministic
work: Use normalized exact matching before controlled aliases.
Return unresolved account/category as a required user choice.
Use source voice for confirmed voice transactions.
Support explicit spoken dates when present; otherwise preview today as default.

tasks.title: Make multi-food meal saves atomic
work: Validate every parsed food before save.
Persist all foods in one transaction or save none.
Return per-food validation messages before confirmation.

tasks.title: Correct provider naming and response contract
work: Rename AI fallback UI text from Gemini to provider-neutral AI nutrition estimate, or switch implementation to Gemini.
Rename route and state identifiers where safe, preserving backward compatibility where needed.
Define typed response schema with source, provider, nutrition basis, verification state, and warnings.

tasks.title: Add AI result review before meal save
work: Show source and estimate warning.
Allow editing name, quantity, unit, calories, protein, carbs, and fat.
Require explicit Add Meal confirmation after review.
Keep manual entry as an immediate alternative.

tasks.title: Harden AI fallback and cache policy
work: Add request timeout and limited exponential retry for rate limits.
Do not scrape arbitrary search snippets by default; use trusted data source or mark result unverified.
Store AI source, provider, model, generated_at, verification status, and nutrition basis.
Do not promote unverified AI result to normal cache search result until user verifies it.

tasks.title: Secure and stabilize search endpoints
work: Require authenticated user where product policy requires it.
Escape user input before MongoDB regex queries.
Add query length limits and per-user/IP throttling.
Return consistent actionable error codes for empty result, quota, timeout, and provider failure.

tasks.title: Add regression coverage and observability
work: Unit test nutrition normalization and AI response validation.
Integration test voice parse, confirmation, cancellation, and persistence.
Integration test local result, AI fallback, provider failure, and manual fallback.
Add structured error logging without transcript or API credential leakage.

open_questions.question: AI food fallback provider should be which option?
open_questions.answer: Try Gemini first. Fall back to OpenRouter only for Gemini high-request, quota, rate-limit, overload, or service-unavailable failures.
open_questions.impact: Gemini becomes primary provider. OpenRouter remains resilience fallback.

open_questions.question: Can unverified AI food results enter shared FoodCache automatically?
open_questions.answer: Yes. This is a single-user PWA, so AI and non-AI food entries can be cached directly.
open_questions.impact: Keep source/provider metadata so cached AI entries remain traceable and editable.

open_questions.question: Voice confirmation scope should be what?
open_questions.answer: Confirm finance only. Save voice meals after validation without a confirmation step.
open_questions.impact: Financial records stay protected while meal logging stays fast.

open_questions.question: When voice command account/category does not match, should user choose it or should system use defaults?
open_questions.answer: Use only an unambiguous spoken match or existing default category. Otherwise require user choice. Never use first-record fallback.
open_questions.decision_owner: Codex recommendation accepted for single-user PWA
open_questions.impact: Avoids unrelated account/category records without adding a new account-settings migration.

open_questions.question: For gram-based nutrition, should canonical FoodCache storage be per gram or per 100g?
open_questions.answer: Store gram-based nutrition per 1 gram. Convert AI and manual 100g input at API boundary.
open_questions.decision_owner: Codex recommendation accepted for single-user PWA
open_questions.impact: Matches current calculation path and avoids repeated /100 conversion bugs.

implementation_notes: Preserve direct cache writes for single-user workflow.
Keep provider/source metadata even when caching directly.
Finance confirmation must block any balance-changing write until user confirms.
